message:
Oops. Actually, Michelle, I didn't wanna link you cause it was kind of a teasing reference to your recent worries about time, and I thought "Hey, it might not be polite for *me* to joke publicly about her concerns." So I was kinda shy about stepping on your toes, or I woulda totally linked it: but, yeah, I gave it some thought. So: my apologies, and when I'm trying to give you a hard time, I'll definitely link you in the future. ;)

Thanks for the perspective, BTW. It's a good point, and I hope I might have that kind of effect on a student.
